note: Adapted from the species description of Emerson. The original is in English; only the alate is treated, with no soldier or worker recorded. Measurements are given only for the alate and its wings; queen measurements are not recorded. Figure numbers, localities and derivation of the name are omitted.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head brown, each hair leaving a small pale dot on the head surface; oval; fontanelle concolorous with head, indistinct, elongate. Antennae 15-segmented, segment 3 equal to segment 4, segment 2 slightly longer. Compound eyes medium-sized, rather close to the lower margin of the head; the eye pigment is not dark in the specimen examined, possibly related to preservation. Ocellus medium-sized, directed laterally; separated from compound eye by less than its width. Postclypeus rather long, paler than head; median line present. Pronotum paler than head, with a pale Y-shaped marking at middle; anterior margin slightly concave; sides rounded; posterior margin slightly concave. Posterior margins of meso- and metanotum broadly concave. Wings transparent. Abdominal tergites slightly paler than pronotum. Body length with wings 14.00 mm; body length (without wings) 8.00 mm; head length 1.47 mm; head width 1.27 mm; antennal length 2.00 mm; compound eye diameter 0.38 mm; pronotum 0.66 mm long, 1.20 mm wide; hind tibia 1.33 mm long; forewing 12.00 mm long, 3.10 mm wide.
